lifecycles._note: reachability-only (owner 2026-06-16): license-gated engine (Vertica DBaaS, create takes a license field), access-tested, license/4xx/5xx tolerated, no functional validation; this is the engine's reachability-TERMINAL final state (NOT held/blocked-owner). Every endpoint is CALLED with optional:true + tolerant expect_status [200,201,202,400,401,403,404,409,422,500]; any 2xx is torn down (DELETEs destructive:true); no real license consumed, no billable-persistent cluster created. COVERAGE-ONLY guarded lifecycle for the vertica (analytics DB DBaaS) cluster sub-op WRITE endpoints. vertica has ZERO GAP-write endpoints in spec.coverage_gap because every write shares a /v1/clusters/* or /v1/instance-groups/* path already matched by the shared DBaaS scenarios (the gap analyzer matches path-only, ignoring service). This lifecycle re-exercises those writes (add-block-storages/resize/restart/start/stop/sync-state/maintenance/backup/security-group-rules/patch/restore/remove-backup-histories/set-block-storage-size) so they ALSO record under vertica's OWN catalog keys in the dashboard (the engine records WRITE steps per (method,path,service)), and includes a probe-reads step to exercise vertica's two id-bound GETs (verticashowrequest, verticalistengineversionproperties via the engine-version list). Does NOT provision a real billable cluster: soft-captures an EXISTING cluster_id/engine_version_id from the read-only lists; when none exists the {cluster_id}/{instance_group_id}/{block_storage_group_id} tokens still normalize to the catalog '*' key so each endpoint is CALLED and RECORDED (a 4xx counts as covered). Every mutating step optional + grouped + broad expect_status; DELETEs destructive:true. heavy:true gates behind SCP_RUN_HEAVY. Bodies best-effort from path/field semantics + data/api_bodies.json verticacreatecluster shape — UNPROVEN, promote after a real 2xx.
